scope: Codex exec CLI input/attachment surface relevant to SEPARATE_VERIFIED_CONTEXT_V1

observations: codex exec accepts an optional positional PROMPT as the initial instructions
when stdin is piped while PROMPT is present, stdin is appended as a <stdin> block
the inspected exec CLI surface has no generic separate verified text-context file/input argument
--image attaches image files to the initial prompt
--add-dir only adds directories writable alongside the primary workspace
the inspected shared CLI surface has no generic separate verified text-context attachment argument

reason: The current codex exec CLI surface does not expose the independent verified text-context channel required by V8.4; prompt and piped stdin are prompt content, image is image-only, and add-dir is workspace access rather than context injection.
limitations: This is upstream source inspection, not execution of the user's locally installed Codex binary.
Before any future real conformance attempt, record local codex --version and codex exec --help and compare them with this upstream surface.
A different API/app-server adapter may expose richer structured inputs, but adopting one is an architecture change and is not implied by this evidence.
